# Gardells intåg pressar ledningen

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-07-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

DI's 'Kort och lång' episode opens with macro worries: war-related bombing in Iran, oil near $100 and long-term real interest rates rising to levels last seen in 2022, which the hosts see as the main threat to stocks. They cover the Q2 reports: Securitas fell sharply, while Stillfront, Enity and Hoist rallied. Other topics are Cevian (Christer Gardell) taking a 5.1% activist stake in Essity, a surprising CEO exit at Beijer Ref, and heavy AI capex at Alphabet and Tesla's drop. They end with a long debate on AI concentration and bubble risk, and both hosts expect the market to rise next week ('buy the dip').

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ESSITY-B — Essity | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Cevian took a 5.1% stake; activist pressure for structural change; low valuation, strong balance sheet, buybacks.

#### Reasoning

The host is clearly long for the long term. Cevian/Gardell is a long-term activist with about SEK 10bn committed, likely to push management and possibly spin-offs. Valuation is about P/E 13, the balance sheet is strong after the Vinda sale and buybacks are ongoing, so the host sees limited downside. The stock has done nothing since the spin-off, so there is room for a catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- Cevian exits or fails to push through structural change
- consumer market weakens further
- no pickup in growth or margins

> *"Jag är klart lång på lång sikt. Man kommer in ganska fördelaktigt. Det känns inte som nedsidan är jättestor i den."*

---

### 🟠 SECU-B — Securitas | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fell 10-15% on a weak Q2; both hosts neutral now and would go long around SEK 130.

#### Reasoning

This was the first miss after years of steady execution since the Stanley deal. The stock had run up to above SEK 170 before the report. Hosts wait to see whether it is a one-off or the start of a trend. Both would buy near SEK 130.

#### Sell Triggers

- further earnings misses showing structural weakness
- growth stays at zero next quarter

> *"Skulle aktien börja komma ner mot 130 kronor, då är jag lång."*

---

### 🟢 ENITY — Enity | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Turnaround report: net interest income +8-9%, operating profit +10-11%, at P/E 7; lower P/E and higher growth than the big banks.

#### Reasoning

After two weak reports and a de-rating, the latest quarter showed a turnaround. At about 7x forward earnings with higher growth than the big banks, the host thinks it 'feels very good'. Rising credit losses are the risk, though still low at 0.27%.

#### Sell Triggers

- credit losses rise materially
- net interest income growth stalls again

> *"Kan man då köpa det på P 7 så tycker jag det känns väldigt bra."*

---

### 🟡 BEIJ-B — Beijer Ref | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Surprise CEO exit with 22 days' notice. Host: 'short-term short, long-term long' on the change to Melker Schörling ownership.

#### Reasoning

The CEO leaves abruptly, possibly for an EQT-linked role. Organic growth of 2.6% and a -25% share price over his tenure were weak. The host likes Melker Schörling replacing EQT as owner but expects near-term uncertainty.

#### Sell Triggers

- CEO recruitment drags on
- organic growth stays weak

> *"Det är jag kanske lång men kortsiktigt kort, långsiktigt lång."*

---

### ⛔ TSLA — Tesla | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

About 1% margin after price cuts; Musk's focus moving to SpaceX; the 'Elon bubble' should gradually deflate.

#### Reasoning

Tesla is valued on Musk magic rather than as a carmaker. With a thin margin and Musk's attention on the listed SpaceX, the host expects the premium to fade ('could get bloody'). Its high multiple makes it sensitive to rising rates.

#### Sell Triggers

- breakthrough in self-driving monetisation
- margin recovery

> *"Då ska man väl successivt blåsa ur den här Elon-bubblan ur Trasslas värdering. Det kan nog bli lite... Lite blodigt, känner jag."*

---

### ⛔ BRAV — Bravida | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Data-centre beneficiary but exposed when hyperscaler capex eventually falls.

#### Reasoning

The host warns against buying data-centre builders as a 'safe' AI play. Hyperscaler capex drives the whole chain, and Google's negative FCF implies capex must fall at some point, which would hit Bravida hard.

#### Sell Triggers

- n/a - avoid thesis invalidated if hyperscaler capex keeps rising for years

> *"Och då kommer ju det slå väldigt hårt mot att Bravida och så vidare."*

---

### 🟠 AXFO — Axfood | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Closest non-AI hiding place in Stockholm; cheaper after a double-digit fall on its half-year report.

#### Reasoning

The market is highly concentrated in AI. Hosts see value in holding some AI-neutral names, and Axfood was named as the obvious candidate after its de-rating.

#### Sell Triggers

- further earnings disappointment

> *"Då är det väl Axfood närmast och den blev ju billigare här senaste halvårsrapporten."*

---

### 🟠 HOFI — Hoist Finance | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Rallied on a report continuing a very successful year.

#### Reasoning

The host notes an 'incredibly successful' run and a strong spread versus Intrum, but has not read the report closely.

#### Sell Triggers

- momentum reverses in next report

> *"Otroligt framgångsrikt."*

---
